signOut.title: Sign out of ChainTrack?
signOut.body: You'll need your password to sign in again on this device.
signOut.label: Sign out

verified.title: Approve this organisation?
verified.body: It can issue, hand over and receive passports straight away, and its signing key is created. The decision and your note are recorded.
verified.label: Approve organisation

changes_requested.title: Ask for changes?
changes_requested.body: The organisation sees your note and can upload new documents. It stays unable to trade until it is approved.
changes_requested.label: Ask for changes

rejected.title: Reject this organisation?
rejected.body: The organisation sees your note. It can't trade; it may upload new documents to be reviewed again.
rejected.label: Reject organisation

accredit.title: Save these accreditations?
accredit.body: The organisation may issue exactly the certificate types ticked, within the dates given. The ledger records the change.
accredit.label: Save accreditations

decline.title: Remove every accreditation?
decline.body: The organisation can no longer issue certificates. Certificates it already issued stay valid.
decline.label: Remove accreditations

flagAssign.title: Take this flag?
flagAssign.body: You become its investigator; others see it's yours.
flagAssign.label: Assign to me

flagUnassign.title: Let go of this flag?
flagUnassign.body: It goes back to the queue without an investigator.
flagUnassign.label: Unassign
